title: Complete Cyclic Subtask Graphs for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Flexibility, Cost, and Bottlenecks in Long-Horizon Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2604.22820v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-horizon tool-using tasks sometimes benefit from revisiting earlier subtasks, but explicit revisitation also adds routing, coordination, and token cost. We study complete cyclic subtask graphs for large language model (LLM) agents: a workflow controller in which executable subtasks are fully connected and a unified state-analysis-and-routing agent selects transitions from natural-language criteria. We evaluate task-specific (Spec-Cyc) and benchmark-generic (Gen-Cyc) cyclic graphs on TextCraft, ALFWorld, and Finance-Agent against ReAct and dependency-directed workflows. Our main dependency-directed controller is DepDAG, which permits same-subtask retry while preserving forward dependency constraints. The evaluated case studies suggest three workflow signatures rather than a universal architecture ranking. translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.22820v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：长时程工具使用任务有时受益于重新访问早期子任务，但显式重访也会增加路由、协调和令牌成本。我们研究了大型语言模型（LLM）代理的完全循环子任务图：一种工作流控制器，其中可执行子任务完全连接，一个统一的状态分析和路由代理根据自然语言标准选择转换。我们在TextCraft、ALFWorld和Finance-Agent上，针对ReAct和依赖导向的工作流，评估了任务特定（Spec-Cyc）和基准通用（Gen-Cyc）的循环图。我们的主要依赖导向控制器是DepDAG，它允许同一子任务重试，同时保留前向依赖约束。评估的案例研究表明，存在三种工作流特征，而非通用的架构排名。TextCraft表现为类似前置条件链的设置，其中循环路由通常增加开销。ALFWorld表现为类似部分...
tldr: 本研究通过比较完全循环子任务图与依赖导向控制器，发现长时程工具使用工作流中循环路由的适用性取决于任务特征，而非通用最优架构。
en_tdlr: This study compares complete cyclic subtask graphs with dependency-directed controllers, revealing that the suitability of cyclic routing in long-horizon tool-using workflows depends on task characteristics, rather than a universally optimal architecture.
